scripts.test:python: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project python pytest python/tests
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:python
scripts.tournament: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project python python -m spy_predictor_quant.tournament --config config/target-tournament.json --repo-root .
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /migrations/001_foundation.sql'
scripts.db:verify: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /migrations/verify_foundation.sql'
scripts.check:db: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:verify && npm run db:integration
